note: A census of the repair checkpoint taken before any content was moved, now complete. Each entry is a section that existed at capture time. `unmoved` and `partial` are transitional and must be zero. `moved` names the file its content went to and its heading must be gone from the source. `kept` stays in the source and must say what it keeps and why. Several sections moved into more than one file; `movedTo` names the primary home and the checkpoint's own pointer table carries the full mapping. This file is read by check-docs, and it is the only thing standing between 'moved' and 'lost' — update it as part of the move that changes a section, never afterwards from memory.
